==Description==
'''Old Man Candy Cane''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 34 of the regular [[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] track. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to interact with it but they can walk while performing it.

Upon use, the player will hold a candy cane that acts as a walking aid.

It had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|1,215}} or {{Robux|143}} ({{Robux|114}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale), with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|18,720}} or {{Robux|3,570}} ({{Robux|2,842}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).
